encoding.reuse: Existing validated variants are reused only when source and output hashes match. ffmpeg_version identifies the current validation/encoding tool; reused files may use an earlier encoder.
encoding.timing: Rebuild timestamps from PCM sample positions, retaining the source initial timestamp. No silence added or audio samples deliberately trimmed.

rights: Each variant retains the source asset's existing rights and attribution; no new audio was sourced.
measurement: Decode with FFmpeg to float32 PCM; RMS and absolute peak across all channels. Compare decoded amplitude to its decoded original. Container timing and decoded sample counts are checked separately for Vorbis padding.
